pairs.subject: canvas-graph
pairs.evidence: apps/console/src/pages/simulator/SimScreen.tsx:93 The canvas's accessible name counts the drawn tiles. useSimGrid caps those at the latest 40 (tilesInView), so with more than 40 tournaments a screen reader hears "40 tournaments" while the visible HUD says "Latest 40 of N". This is the 'name counts the graph, not the drawing' failure.

techniques.evidence: apps/console/src/pages/simulator/SimScreen.tsx:93 tiles is capped at MAX_TILES (data.ts useSimGrid → tilesInView), so the name states the drawn subset as if it were the total. The canvas is also role="img" (line 92) yet its tiles respond to mouse clicks only, with no tabIndex or key handler. The Doors nav to the Tournaments list works as a keyboard twin.

apps/console/src/pages/simulator/grid.ts:92 There is no camera, but the mapping has one authority: forward tileOrigin (grid.ts:76) and inverse hitTest sit side by side in grid.ts. They are round-trip tested at model.test.ts:40-41 (tileOrigin(l,13) then hitTest → 13). Gap pixels map to the tile on their left, and the round-trip test never covers the gaps.

apps/console/src/pages/simulator/SimScreen.tsx:55 No animation loop at rest (rung 5). The scene repaints only when tiles, size or hover change. drawGrid caches colours per health value, and there is no pan for rung 1 to protect.

apps/console/src/pages/simulator/grid.ts:52 A tile's slot is its ordinal index in a capped sliding window: tileOrigin(l, i) at grid.ts:77. Once there are more than 40 tournaments, each new arrival moves every existing tile one slot. The technique names this failure: anything that changes the set re-places every member, and a draw cap must not move a node. The layout is otherwise pure and deterministic.

apps/console/src/pages/simulator/SimScreen.tsx:99 The only pointer gestures are hover hit-testing and a native click that opens a tournament. There is no drag, no marquee-drag selection and no pointer capture, so click-vs-drag disambiguation has no rival gesture to separate. The "marquee" here is a hover label, not a selection rectangle.
apps/console/src/pages/simulator/grid.ts:1 The model is tiles and run cells only. No connections between tiles are modelled or drawn, so there are no edges to anchor, route or thin out.

pairs.registryProposal: The golden path's precondition is relationship editing, but the subject gets matched to canvas-drawn small multiples with no edges, like this tile grid. graph-layout's 'derive the slot from identity' rule clashes with a chronological 'latest N' window, where an ordinal slot deliberately encodes recency. The technique could name this case: a recency grid either accepts a re-seat on each arrival as its stated policy, or reserves an arrival slot. Either way it should be declared, not inherited by accident.
